about.title: About Loan Calculator
about.description: The Loan Calculator helps you determine monthly payments, total interest costs, and amortization schedules for any type of loan. Whether it's a mortgage, auto loan, personal loan, or business loan, this tool provides comprehensive loan analysis. Understanding your loan terms before signing helps you make informed financial decisions and compare different loan offers effectively. Calculate the true cost of borrowing and plan your budget accordingly.

faq.q: What's included in the monthly loan payment calculation?
faq.a: The basic loan calculator includes principal and interest (P&I) payments. For mortgages, you may need to add property taxes, homeowners insurance, and PMI separately for the total monthly housing payment. Our calculator focuses on the core loan payment components.

faq.q: How does the loan term affect my monthly payments?
faq.a: Longer loan terms result in lower monthly payments but higher total interest costs over the loan lifetime. Shorter terms mean higher monthly payments but significant interest savings. Our loan calculator helps you compare different term options to find the right balance.

faq.q: Can I calculate the impact of making extra loan payments?
faq.a: Yes, our loan calculator shows how additional principal payments reduce the loan term and total interest paid. Even small extra payments can save thousands in interest over time and help you pay off loans years earlier.

faq.q: What's the difference between interest rate and APR?
faq.a: Interest rate is the basic cost of borrowing the principal amount. APR (Annual Percentage Rate) includes the interest rate plus additional fees and costs like origination fees, giving you the true annual cost of the loan. Use APR for accurate loan comparisons.

faq.q: What types of loans can I calculate with this tool?
faq.a: Our loan calculator works for any fixed-rate loan including auto loans, personal loans, student loans, business loans, and mortgages. Simply enter the loan amount, interest rate, and term to get accurate payment calculations.

faq.q: How accurate are the loan payment calculations?
faq.a: Our loan calculator uses standard amortization formulas used by banks and lenders, providing highly accurate payment estimates. However, actual payments may vary slightly due to rounding, fees, or specific lender calculation methods.
